sections.name: strict detached global maps and complete public rules
native70 pure ticket outcomes and RNG parity
every exact map conserves tickets, actual outcomes, payout and return
profiles keep all stake-grid costs and maximum liability; identity pins before RNG
atomic settings validate all parts, reject stale and active updates, increment once

allNineRange.coverage: All414 catalogue/form/evidence values; integer bounds; atomic accepted future profiles; stale/busy rejection; unchanged Blackjack cap and payouts; unique finite six-deck cards; RTP control JSX; source-specific slot evidence and honest shared-calibration labels.

blackjackEvidence.coverage: Unchanged physical engine SHA; all46 pinned public ticket pairs; frozen parameter digest; independent seed partition; recomputed payout-count mean and95%CI; approximate labels; native70 retained.

conclusions.fiveClassicGames: Exact integer-ticket distributions for all46 targets, except native70 Upgrader1.5x at69.99%. Native70 outcomes and RNG retained.
conclusions.blackjack: All46 approximate, public, global six-deck312-card draw profiles calibrated for stated basic Hit/Stand strategy. Native70 retained; no exact70 claim.
conclusions.admission: All414 catalogue/form values validated. Full settings atomic, accepted profiles pinned before RNG;49/96/fractions rejected. Prices, payouts and caps preserved.
conclusions.slots: This receipt verifies catalogue/form acceptance and atomic slot profile maps only. Slot distribution/holdout evidence belongs to separate source-specific universal-slot records.
conclusions.liveRules: App passes current classic profiles, stake limits and revision to public OddsRules.
conclusions.limitation: RTP is not a guarantee for individual rounds or player strategies. Monte Carlo intervals describe uncertainty in a sample mean, not an exact theoretical RTP.

blackjack.method: Analytic infinite-deck public-bias pilot; distribution-equivalent finite six-deck rank-count calibration with at least1000000hands per preset and disjoint SHA256-seeded sfc32 streams. Parameter table frozen before separate100000-hand holdout per preset on unchanged physical312-card blackjack.js engine. Rejection sampling for unbiased integer tickets. No failures retried, no bankroll stops, no post-result payout changes.
blackjack.policy: Standard six-deck S17 hit/stand. Hard12 stands vs4–6; hard13–16 stands vs2–6; hard17+ stands. Soft18 stands vs2–8; soft19+ stands. Only visible player cards and dealer upcard; no doubles, splits, surrender or insurance.
blackjack.limitation: Every Blackjack RTP is approximate and strategy dependent. Profile70 deliberately retains the native3200/1500 ticket rules; its independently measured basic return is about70.95%, not exactly70%. Physical six-deck312-card engine and payouts are unchanged.
